nodes.label: FastAPI router for QA AgentOS Runs API.
Create and schedule an agent run, with deterministic idempotency support.
List runs visible to the authenticated project.

Cancel a queued or running run.
Replay an existing run with identical parameters and pinned or re-resolved…
